card.name: Final digit or scale word in numbers
card.fires_on: The last digit 0 of a multi-digit number, or a scale word like million, right before a unit such as mg, kg, ms or gallons. It sits in dose, weight, interval and quantity statements.

modes.label: Trailing zero in a number
modes.description: The final 0 of a round number such as 400 or 80 just before a unit like mg, kg or ms.
modes.example: Do not exceed a total daily dosage of 40<<0>> mg in 24 hours.

modes.label: Scale word
modes.description: The word million after a number, just before a unit of volume.
modes.example: withdrawing 86.4<< million>> gallons of water per day in 2

card.writes: It pushes the model toward measurement unit words such as units, liters, volts and inches coming next.
card.plain: It marks the end of a number, just before the unit such as mg or kg is written.
